description_en: Performs a paged query for service endpoints in a specified workspace. Supports paging and filtering by target type, agent, collaboration component, and status
description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间内的服务端点，支持按目标类型、智能体、协作组件和状态过滤
name: ListServiceEndpoints

parameters.help_en: Filters by target type. Valid values: AGENT_VERSION and TEAM_COLLABORATION
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en: Filters by the target agent ID
parameters.help_zh: 按目标智能体 ID 过滤
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: Filters by the target agent version number
parameters.help_zh: 按目标智能体版本号过滤
parameters.name: agent_version

parameters.help_en: Filters by the workspace resource binding ID of the target collaboration component
parameters.help_zh: 按目标协作组件的工作空间资源绑定 ID 过滤
parameters.name: resource_binding_id

parameters.help_en: Filters by collaboration component type. Valid values: MATRIX_CLIENT, MATRIX_FEDERATION, and ELEMENT_WEB
parameters.help_zh: 按协作组件类型过滤。可选值：MATRIX_CLIENT、MATRIX_FEDERATION、ELEMENT_WEB
parameters.name: collaboration_component

parameters.help_en: Filters by service endpoint status. Valid values: CREATING, READY, UPDATING, DEGRADED, DISABLED, and DELETING
parameters.help_zh: 按服务端点状态过滤。可选值：CREATING、READY、UPDATING、DEGRADED、DISABLED、DELETING
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 单页返回的最大记录数，取值范围为 1~100。不指定该参数时默认返回 20 条
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The cursor used to query the next page. Do not specify this parameter in the first call. For subsequent calls, specify the nextToken value returned from the previous call
parameters.help_zh: 查询下一页的游标。首次调用不指定该参数，后续调用指定上一次返回的 nextToken
parameters.name: next_token

accessUrls.description_en: The list of access URLs for the service endpoint
accessUrls.description_zh: 服务端点的访问地址列表

accessType.description_en: The type of the access URL. Valid values: INTERNET and VPC

status.description_en: The status of the access URL. Valid values: CREATING, READY, and DEGRADED

statusReason.description_en: The reason for the access URL status. Returns the specific reason when the status is abnormal
statusReason.description_zh: 访问地址状态原因。状态异常时返回具体原因
statusReason.example: ServiceEndpoint.Provider.Unavailable: no provider for the target type

authentication.description_en: The authentication configuration of the service endpoint

type.description_en: The authentication method. NONE indicates that no authentication is required. API_KEY indicates that authentication is performed by passing an API key in the x-api-key request header
type.description_zh: 鉴权方式。NONE 表示无需鉴权，API_KEY 表示通过 x-api-key 请求头传递 API Key 进行鉴权

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in UTC format compliant with RFC 3339
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

currentInstances.description_en: Read-only. This is a shared response field. The list operation does not query the resource manager row by row and returns null. For details, call the GetServiceEndpoint operation to query sandboxPhaseCounts.RUNNING based on the endpoint runtimeKey. Do not replace this value with the baseline upper and lower limits, target quantity, or READY status
currentInstances.description_zh: 只读，共用响应字段；列表不逐行查询 RM，返回 null。详情通过 GetServiceEndpoint 按 Endpoint runtimeKey 查询 sandboxPhaseCounts.RUNNING，不以基础上下限、目标数量或 READY 状态替代

effectivePublicAccessEnabled.description_en: The result of combining publicAccessEnabled with the public inbound access upper limit of the workspace. The value is true only when both allow public inbound access. This field only indicates the policy target and does not mean that the public endpoint has been published. The actual status is subject to accessUrls and status
effectivePublicAccessEnabled.description_zh: publicAccessEnabled 与工作空间公网入向上限叠加后的结果：二者均允许时为 true。仅表示策略目标，不代表公网入口已发布完成，实际状态以 accessUrls 与 status 为准
effectivePublicAccessEnabled.title_en: 服务端点公网入向的有效期望值
effectivePublicAccessEnabled.title_zh: 服务端点公网入向的有效期望值

elasticityPolicy.description_en: Includes the enabled status, basic minSandboxCount and maxSandboxCount, and dynamicPolicy. This does not represent the currently effective limits or the actual number of instances. If the basic configuration lacks dynamicPolicy before the feature is released, it is supplemented with enabled=false and policies=[]. This parameter is null if the endpoint configuration is not saved, and the list does not backfill the version source. Historical basic capacity can exceed 100. Retrieve the details again when you open the edit page
elasticityPolicy.description_zh: 包含 enabled、基础 minSandboxCount/maxSandboxCount 和 dynamicPolicy；不是当前生效上下限或实际实例数。需求上线前的基础配置缺 dynamicPolicy 时补为 enabled=false、policies=[]。未保存 Endpoint 配置时为 null，列表不回填版本来源；历史基础容量可超过 100。打开编辑时重新获取详情

dynamicPolicy.description_en: Returns the saved dynamic configuration. If the basic configuration lacks dynamicPolicy before the feature is released, it is supplemented with enabled=false and policies=[]
dynamicPolicy.description_zh: 返回保存的动态配置；需求上线前的基础配置缺 dynamicPolicy 时补为 enabled=false、policies=[]

enabled.description_en: Required during creation. If omitted during an update, the original value is retained. Disabling it retains existing policies and restores the basic upper and lower limits. Enabling it again triggers immediate calculation. When finally enabled, policies must not be empty
enabled.description_zh: 创建时必填；更新时省略保留原值。关闭保留已有策略并恢复基础上下限，重新开启立即计算；最终开启时 policies 不得为空

policies.description_en: Required during creation. If omitted during an update, the original list is retained. If provided, the entire list is replaced rather than merged by ID. To clear the list, you must also ensure that the final enabled status is false. Each item must be complete. Conditional requirements and cross-field constraints are validated by the server. The display order does not indicate priority
policies.description_zh: 创建时必填；更新时省略保留原列表，传入即整体替换，不按 id 合并。清空须同时保证最终 enabled=false。每项必须完整，条件必填和跨字段约束由服务端校验；显示顺序不作为优先级

endTime.description_en: Required only when validity is set to range. The format is the same as startTime, and the seconds are fixed at 00. The end time must be later than the start time. The interval does not include the end time. If validity is set to forever, the start and end times must be omitted. Valid dates and cross-field constraints are verified by the console
endTime.description_zh: 仅 validity=range 必填，格式与 startTime 相同，秒位固定 00，必须晚于 startTime；区间不包含结束时刻。forever 必须省略起止时间；合法日期和跨字段约束由 Console 校验

id.description_en: Required. It must be unique and stable within the endpoint. It is generated by the frontend when added, and retained during editing and retries
id.description_zh: 必填，Endpoint 内唯一且稳定；新增时由前端生成，编辑和重试保留

priority.description_en: Required. 5 indicates normal priority, and 10 indicates high priority. New policies default to normal priority. It must be explicitly provided during submission, as the API does not set a default value. When dynamicPolicy.enabled is finally true, the validity periods of high-priority policies must not overlap, except that end-to-end connection is allowed, and long-term high-priority policies can overlap with other high-priority policies. Overlapping drafts can be saved when disabled, and the final configuration is validated when re-enabled. The validity of other fields and trigger conflicts within the policy are always validated. The priority must be explicitly provided
priority.description_zh: 必填，5 为常规，10 为高优；新增策略默认选择常规，提交时显式携带，不设置接口默认值。最终 dynamicPolicy.enabled=true 时，高优策略之间有效期不得重叠，首尾相接允许，长期高优与其他高优重叠；关闭时允许保存重叠草稿，重新开启时校验最终配置。其他字段合法性与策略内触发冲突始终校验；priority 必须显式提供

repeat.description_en: Required. daily means every day, weekly means every week, and monthly means every month. Only submit the fields corresponding to the specified cycle
repeat.description_zh: 必填。daily 为每天，weekly 为每星期，monthly 为每月；仅提交对应周期的字段

startTime.description_en: Required only when validity is set to range. The format is YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss in the policy time zone, without a time zone offset. The seconds are fixed at 00. The interval includes the start time. When you edit the policy, the existing past start time is retained. The update or retry is not rejected even if the start time is earlier than the current time
startTime.description_zh: 仅 validity=range 必填，策略时区下的 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss，不带时区偏移，秒位固定 00。区间包含开始时刻；编辑保留已有的过去开始时间，不因其早于当前时间拒绝更新或重试

timePoints.description_en: Required and non-empty. Each item must be complete. The day of the week or day of the month is configured independently for each item. Within the same policy, daily policies conflict if they have the same time. Weekly and monthly policies conflict only if they have the same time and their date sets intersect. This is validated by the console
timePoints.description_zh: 必填且非空，每项必须完整。星期或月日期由每项独立配置。同一策略内，daily 相同 time 冲突，weekly/monthly 仅在 time 相同且日期集合相交时冲突，由 Console 校验

minInstances.description_en: Required. Valid values: 0 to 100. The value cannot be greater than the maxInstances value in the same item
minInstances.description_zh: 必填，0～100，且不大于同项 maxInstances

monthDays.description_en: Required only for each trigger point of the monthly cycle. The values must be non-empty, deduplicated integers from 1 to 31. Each row is selected independently. If a date does not exist in a specific month, the trigger does not occur and is not postponed to the end of the month. This field must be omitted for other cycles
monthDays.description_zh: 仅 monthly 的每个触发点必填，非空且去重，整数 1～31；每行独立选择，月份不存在的日期不触发，不顺延到月末。其他周期必须省略

items.description_en: The day of the month, ranging from 1 to 31. Triggers do not occur on dates that do not exist in the current month
items.description_zh: 月内日期，范围为 1～31，所在月份不存在的日期不触发
items.title_en: 月内日期，范围为 1～31，所在月份不存在的日期不触发。
items.title_zh: 月内日期，范围为 1～31，所在月份不存在的日期不触发。

time.description_en: Required. The format is HH:mm:ss. The time is interpreted based on the time zone of the associated policy. The precision is down to the minute, and the seconds are fixed at 00
time.description_zh: 必填，HH:mm:ss，按所属策略时区解释，精确到分钟，秒位固定 00

weekdays.description_en: Required only for each trigger point of weekly policies. It must be non-empty and deduplicated, with integers from 1 to 7, where 1 represents Monday and 7 represents Sunday. Each row is selected independently. It must be omitted for other cycles
weekdays.description_zh: 仅 weekly 的每个触发点必填，非空且去重，整数 1～7，1 为周一、7 为周日；每行独立选择。其他周期必须省略

items.description_en: The day of the week index, where 1 represents Monday and 7 represents Sunday
items.description_zh: 星期序号，1 为周一，7 为周日
items.title_en: 星期序号，1 为周一，7 为周日。
items.title_zh: 星期序号，1 为周一，7 为周日。

timeZone.description_en: Required. A valid IANA time zone. All dates and times in this policy are interpreted in this time zone
timeZone.description_zh: 必填，合法 IANA 时区。本策略所有日期和时间均在该时区下解释

validity.description_en: Required. Valid values: forever and range. forever indicates long-term validity, and range indicates short-term validity. After expiration, the policy and its trigger results exit the current calculation, and the remaining policies are recalculated. If no candidate restores the baseline value, the saved configurations are not automatically deleted
validity.description_zh: 必填，forever 为长期有效，range 为短期有效。到期后策略及其触发结果退出当前计算并重算剩余策略；无候选恢复基础值，保存的配置不自动删除

enabled.description_en: Independent of dynamicPolicy.enabled. If omitted during an update, the original value is retained
enabled.description_zh: 与 dynamicPolicy.enabled 独立。更新时省略表示保留原值
enabled.title_en: 是否开启整个自动弹性模式
enabled.title_zh: 是否开启整个自动弹性模式

maxSandboxCount.description_en: The saved or backfilled basic maximum number of instances. It must not be less than minSandboxCount. Historical values can exceed 100 and are not truncated when read. The basic value is used when dynamic scaling is disabled or no candidates are available
maxSandboxCount.description_zh: 保存或回填的基础最大实例数，不小于 minSandboxCount。历史值可超过 100，读取不截断；动态关闭或无候选时使用基础值
maxSandboxCount.title_en: 保存的基础最大实例数
maxSandboxCount.title_zh: 保存的基础最大实例数

minSandboxCount.description_en: The saved or backfilled basic minimum number of instances. It must be a non-negative integer and not greater than maxSandboxCount. Historical values can exceed 100 and are not truncated when read. However, newly written complete configurations must still meet the 0 to 100 range
minSandboxCount.description_zh: 保存或回填的基础最小实例数，非负且不大于 maxSandboxCount。历史值可超过 100，读取不截断；新写入的完整配置仍须满足 0～100
minSandboxCount.title_en: 保存的基础最小实例数
minSandboxCount.title_zh: 保存的基础最小实例数

elasticityPolicy.title_en: 服务端点保存的完整弹性配置
elasticityPolicy.title_zh: 服务端点保存的完整弹性配置

endpointType.description_en: The type of the service endpoint. DEFAULT indicates a default endpoint created and maintained by the platform, and NAMED indicates a named endpoint explicitly created by a user
endpointType.description_zh: 服务端点类型。DEFAULT 表示由平台创建并维护的默认端点，NAMED 表示用户显式创建的命名端点

name.description_en: The name of the service endpoint. The name must be unique within the workspace and be 1 to 128 characters in length
name.description_zh: 服务端点名称。在工作空间内唯一，长度为 1~128 个字符

publicAccessEnabled.description_en: The expected public inbound access configured by the user on the service endpoint. For historical service endpoints that have not been configured, true is returned. This field only indicates the configuration expectation. The actual availability of the public IP address is subject to accessUrls and status
publicAccessEnabled.description_zh: 用户在服务端点上设置的公网入向期望；未设置过的历史服务端点按 true 返回。仅表示配置期望，实际公网地址是否可用以 accessUrls 与 status 为准
publicAccessEnabled.title_en: 服务端点公网入向开关的期望值
publicAccessEnabled.title_zh: 服务端点公网入向开关的期望值

regionId.description_en: The region ID of the service endpoint
regionId.description_zh: 服务端点所在的地域 ID

serviceEndpointId.description_en: The ID of the service endpoint

status.description_en: The status of the service endpoint. Valid values: CREATING, READY, UPDATING, DEGRADED, DISABLED, and DELETING

statusReason.description_en: The reason for the service endpoint status. Returns the specific reason when the status is abnormal
statusReason.description_zh: 服务端点状态原因。状态异常时返回具体原因
statusReason.example: ServiceEndpoint.Provider.Unavailable: no provider for the target type

target.description_en: The target routing configuration of the service endpoint
target.description_zh: 服务端点的目标路由配置

agentId.description_en: The ID of the target agent. Returned when the target type is AGENT_VERSION
agentId.description_zh: 目标智能体 ID。目标类型为 AGENT_VERSION 时返回

agentVersion.description_en: The version number of the target agent. Returned when the target type is AGENT_VERSION
agentVersion.description_zh: 目标智能体版本号。目标类型为 AGENT_VERSION 时返回

collaborationComponent.description_en: The type of the collaboration component. Returned when the target type is TEAM_COLLABORATION
collaborationComponent.description_zh: 协作组件类型。目标类型为 TEAM_COLLABORATION 时返回

resourceBindingId.description_en: The workspace resource binding ID associated with the target collaboration component. Returned when the target type is TEAM_COLLABORATION
resourceBindingId.description_zh: 目标协作组件关联的工作空间资源绑定 ID。目标类型为 TEAM_COLLABORATION 时返回

targetType.description_en: The target type. Valid values: AGENT_VERSION and TEAM_COLLABORATION

updatedAt.description_en: The time of the last modification in UTC format compliant with RFC 3339
updatedAt.description_zh: 最近一次修改的时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records per page for the current query
maxResults.description_zh: 本次查询生效的单页最大记录数

message.description_en: The response message. Returns an error description if the request fails
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求失败时返回错误描述

nextToken.description_en: The cursor for the next page. This parameter is empty if no next page exists
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页游标。没有下一页时为空

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

totalCount.description_en: The total number of service endpoints that meet the query conditions
totalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的服务端点总数
